About Mannschaft

A language center built around real progress, not just attendance.

Mannschaft Sprachzentrum was founded by language teachers who were tired of oversized classes and one-size-fits-all curricula. We built a school where every group is small enough to notice you, and every lesson is designed around situations you'll actually face — at the Bürgeramt, in a job interview, or catching up with neighbors.

Our mission

Make fluent, confident German achievable for anyone, on a realistic timeline.

Our values

Small groups, honest feedback, and teaching that respects your time and goals.

More about Mannschaft

Exam Preparation

Walk into exam day already knowing you're ready.

Our exam-prep tracks are built around the exact format, timing, and scoring of each test — with mock exams, past-paper drills, and one-to-one writing feedback included.

Learn About Exam Preparation

Goethe-Zertifikat

Internationally recognized German exams accepted by universities, employers, and immigration authorities worldwide.

A1 – B2

telc Deutsch

Practical, standardized exams widely used for visa applications, naturalization, and workplace requirements.

A1 – B2

TestDaF

The standard German exam for university admission, assessing academic language proficiency in one sitting.

B2

DSH

German university entrance exam preparation, tailored to the specific requirements of your target institution.

B2

FAQ

Common questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Our team is happy to help you choose the right course.

View Full FAQ

We teach the full range from A1 (complete beginner) through B2 (upper-intermediate), following the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). New courses start every few weeks, so you can join at the right level after a short placement check.

Group courses are capped at 10 students to make sure everyone gets real speaking practice and personal feedback. We also offer one-to-one and small private group lessons for a more tailored pace.

Yes. Most of our German and exam-preparation courses are available both online with live instructors and in person at our Berlin location, so you can choose whichever fits your routine.

If you’re new to German, you’ll start at A1. If you already have some experience, we offer a free placement assessment to identify the right starting level before your first paid session.

We offer dedicated preparation for the Goethe-Zertifikat, telc Deutsch, TestDaF, and DSH exams, including mock tests, exam strategy, and detailed feedback on writing and speaking sections.

Ready to start speaking German?

Book a free placement conversation with our team and get a personalized course recommendation within 24 hours.
